text:
Priya D.: Hey @Luke (VoltCloud) — we’re finalizing the marketplace cost model and need the raw supply feed you export. Can you share the CSV with reserved vs ephemeral (spot) breakout + any latency premium metadata? Need by EOD Wed if possible.

Luke (VoltCloud): Yup. We currently push a nightly S3 export. What exact columns do you need? (I can add a couple fields if it helps).

Priya D.: Minimal set: sku_id, region, reserved_commit_gpus, reserved_price_per_gpu_hour, reserved_tenor_months, spot_avg_price_per_gpu_hour, spot_volatility_pct, eviction_notice_seconds, latency_premium_ms, listing_fee_pct, currency. Also indicate whether SKU supports burstable capacity and the on-net bandwidth tier.

Mike H.: please add "billing_granularity" (hour/minute) and "price_effective_from" so finance can align. Also call out VAT applicability per region.

Luke (VoltCloud): OK adding `billing_granularity` and `price_effective_from`. VAT is on our invoice side but I can flag region_vat_pct. Quick question — do you want historical spot samples or just the 30d avg + volatility?

Priya D.: 30d avg + volatility_pct is fine. If you can include a small sample (json list or s3 prefix) that’s helpful for sanity checks but not required.

Luke (VoltCloud): Makes sense. I'll add an optional `spot_sample_s3_prefix` column. Example row we’ll send: 
```
sku_id,region,reserved_commit_gpus,reserved_price_per_gpu_hour,reserved_tenor_months,spot_avg_price_per_gpu_hour,spot_volatility_pct,eviction_notice_seconds,latency_premium_ms,listing_fee_pct,currency,billing_granularity,price_effective_from,region_vat_pct,burstable,spot_sample_s3_prefix
vc-a100-80gb,us-west-2,40,3.25,12,1.12,0.22,300,15,0.02,USD,hour,2026-03-01,0.0,true,s3://vc-dumps/spot-samples/vc-a100-80gb/2026-02/
```

Ana G.: For modeling, we also need `eviction_profile` (low/medium/high) or a numeric prob_eviction_per_hour — helps the optimizer choose fallbacks. Can Luke include `prob_eviction_per_hour` if available?

Luke (VoltCloud): I can compute a simple per-hour eviction probability from our telemetry. Will add `prob_eviction_per_hour` (nullable).

Mike H.: One more ask — can you include `preferred_fallback_sku` (if you have compatible cheaper variants) and `compatible_model_variants` (comma list) so runtime can auto-route? Not required in feed but high-value.

Luke (VoltCloud): I’ll include `preferred_fallback_sku` where applicable. `compatible_model_variants` might be noisy but we’ll try to include up to 3.

Priya D.: Perfect. Once you upload, post the s3 path here. We’ll ingest into the cost model pipeline and validate. If you want a quick spec doc I can paste one, otherwise the CSV sample you showed is enough.

marketplace-bot: New S3 object uploaded: s3://vc-exports/marketplace/feeds/2026-03-18/vc-feed-2026-03-18.csv (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e) :rocket:

Luke (VoltCloud): Uploaded and shared the bucket ACL for `redwood-ingest@redwood-inference`. I added `prob_eviction_per_hour` and `preferred_fallback_sku`. Let us know if we need a different timezone for `price_effective_from`.

Priya D.: Got it, thanks. Will kick off validation and report any mismatches. Heads-up: finance may follow up on `listing_fee_pct` rounding and whether fees are net or gross.

Mike H.: ACK. If anyone from deal desk needs to jump in, @Ana G. will coordinate.

Ana G.: Happy to. Priya — I’ll watch the validation output and pick up any edge cases for pricing rules.

Priya D.: Thanks team. Closing loop once model ingestion passes. :thumbsup:
